sections.content: At home, we keep food in specific places. Combine room location words with food vocabulary to describe where meals are prepared.

items.spanish: A konyhában van a kenyér, az asztalon a kávé.
items.english: In the kitchen there is bread, on the table (there is) coffee.
The bed is in the room.
For lunch there will be soup and apple.

sections.content: Combine location (-ban/-ben, -on/-en) with 'van' to describe where items are: 'A konyhaban van' (In the kitchen there is), 'Az asztalon van' (On the table there is).
